name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B Growth Marketer | Account-Level Personalization & AI-Driven Campaigns
summary: Growth marketer and marketing-systems architect with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, agency, and revenue operations, including 5+ years building AI-driven, account-level personalization and outreach systems that turn account signals into targeted, multi-channel campaigns. Founder of Solenzo, where every campaign is scored against an account's digital footprint and buyer signals before outreach goes out. Spent a decade as the sales-side stakeholder these programs are built for before building the marketing systems that drive them, bringing genuine fluency in Sales partnership, account prioritization, and pipeline outcomes.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect AI-driven, account-level marketing systems that score each account's digital footprint and buyer signals to trigger personalized, multi-channel outreach across email, forms, and landing pages.

Built segmented outreach engines targeting website-visibility, missed-call, and low-review signals, plus an automated prospect audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts based on scored account signals.

Architected a complete GoHighLevel marketing-automation system - 20+ workflows spanning lead capture/routing, qualification, appointment booking, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, and reactivation - the reusable playbook infrastructure account-based programs depend on.
Align marketing programs to revenue objectives directly with business owners and sales teams, producing consistent account-specific messaging and qualified lead flow.
Draft clean, specific direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages tailored to each account's context, driving engagement and pipeline.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to business-owner stakeholders.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content, coordinating execution across internal departments as strategic lead.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Produced high-converting campaign assets - landing pages, multi-touch email sequences, conversion-focused copy - improving lead generation and pipeline.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value to their own accounts.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K) - roughly $130K+ in total bookings.
Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled.

Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, building relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute against.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
